title: versions are plans of feature slices that can change without breaking

criteria.text: A feature has slices, each with its own horizon, rank and the conditions it waits on
A version is a record: outcomes, appetite, slices in and left out, each leave-out with a reason and its condition
criteria.note: Built in #1241 [V]. The first real version, VN-0001 (Sacramento beta, due 2027-01-06), now comes in from `scripts/knowledge/versions-seed.json` (#1437, 'Reviewed by: none', counted as data, not building the criterion [A]). Checked: `[guards F127.2]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_plans.sql`.

criteria.text: No feature or slice carries a date; a version may
criteria.note: `due_on` refused on other kinds (#1241) [V]. Checked: `[guards F127.3]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_plans.sql`.

criteria.text: A change of plan is a new version of the plan with a why naming the outcome; the earlier plan stays readable
criteria.note: `replan` in #1241; the seed import changes a plan only through `replan` with a why (#1437) [V]. Checked: `[guards F127.4]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_plans.sql`.

criteria.text: One call each: what a version held on any date, and what changed between two dates, with the whys
Left out is not forgotten: a left-out slice is listed again when its condition is met or its outcome changes
Today's plan comes in: each scenario becomes a feature with one slice carrying its horizon and rank
criteria.note: Import in #1241 (`F###-S1`) [V]. Checked: `[guards F127.7]` in `tests/knowledge-plans.test.ts`. Open bug #1473: the import sets a feature's status only when it first makes it (F137 stays 'draft' after approval); slice horizon and rank are followed.

criteria.text: Nothing breaks: the dashboard and `STATUS.md` are generated from the store after a week side by side
criteria.note: Not built [V]: #1241 body sends it to #1242 (open, no change since 2026-11-11).
